profile.intro: Technically trained candidate with an ITEC in Rapid Transit Technology and practical training in Mechanical Servicing, with a strong interest in mechanical maintenance and technical operations at SMRT.
profile.summary: Technically trained candidate with an ITEC in Rapid Transit Technology and practical training in Mechanical Servicing, with a strong interest in mechanical maintenance and technical operations at SMRT. Brings internship exposure to mechanical and electrical (M&E) services, including equipment inspection and maintenance, BIM model familiarity, technical workflows, commissioning, and testing activities. Strong foundational skills in mechanical servicing, hand tools, workshop practices, basic troubleshooting, equipment inspection, and workplace safety. Demonstrates a methodical, procedure-focused approach with practical problem-solving, attention to detail, and readiness to support safe and reliable rail operations.
